testing_gaps.title: Compare the SQL intake contract with its source
testing_gaps.why_it_matters: A change to the copied SQL contract can silently diverge from the browser contract while these tests stay green. The current assertion only compares the JavaScript public fields with another JavaScript schema; the SQL copy controls server validation and can reject a field the form offers or admit a field the form does not know. Comparing the SQL descriptor with the JavaScript source, as the existing partnership database test does, catches that drift.

testing_gaps.title: Test focus and page restoration event refresh
testing_gaps.why_it_matters: A visitor returning to an open, acknowledged form may keep seeing old terms if the new focus or page-restoration listeners stop working. The tests prove that calling load directly clears acknowledgement after a version change, but would still pass if those browser listeners were removed. An event-driven browser test would verify that the refresh actually occurs when the visitor returns.

testing_gaps.title: Verify intake locking across separate PostgreSQL connections
